def page(items, size, n):

tasks.fix:
def page(items, size, n):
    return items[n * size: (n + 1) * size]
tasks.test:
from m import page


def test_page():
    assert page(list(range(10)), 3, 0) == [0, 1, 2]
    assert page(list(range(10)), 3, 3) == [9]
